LevLoadNrmObj.name: Layer scroll tile loader (check boundaries)
summary: $0586EA: loads one normal level object via CODE_0DA40F (companion of LevLoadExtObj at $0586E3).
$0586F1: called every frame from the level game mode after scrolling. For layer 1 and layer 2 it compares the 16-pixel-aligned scroll
position with the last loaded position ([$4D]-[$50] for layer 1, [$51]-[$54] for layer 2, indexed by scroll direction [$55]/[$56]).
On a change it stores the new position, sets the other direction's slot to $FFFF and calls the column/row loader for the level mode.
Bit 0 / bit 1 of [RAM_IsVerticalLvl] select position X (horizontal) or Y (vertical) for layer 1 / layer 2.

MAP16AppTable.name: Map16 pointer bases and tile range setup
summary: $058776: four 16-bit pointer bases ($8AB0, $84E0, $8AF0, $8B30) used to seed the Map16 pointer table at $0FBE.
$05877E: computes the range of tile columns (or rows) to keep loaded around the screen: [$45] = start - 8 and [$47] = start + $17 for layer 1,
[$49]/[$4B] likewise for layer 2. For horizontal layer 1 it also fills 8 words at $1224 with the base chosen by the column group, step 8.
The Map16 pointer table use is inferred, hedged. Also contains CODE_05881A, the start of the layer 1 loader dispatch (level mode [$1925]).

PtrsLong058823.name: Pointer table: layer 1 loader by level mode
summary: Indexed by level mode [$1925] (3-byte pointers) through ExecutePtrLong from CODE_05881A. Used when scrolling.
Entries select between two layer 1 loaders (CODE_0589CE, probably column; CODE_058A9B, probably row) or a bare RTL.

PtrsLong05888C.name: Pointer table: layer 2 loader by level mode
summary: Indexed by level mode [$1925] through ExecutePtrLong from CODE_058883. Used when scrolling.
Entries are the layer 2 loaders CODE_058B8D / CODE_058C71 or a bare RTL (no layer 2 or no scrolling update).

PtrsLong0588F5.name: Pointer table: layer 1 loader for initial load
summary: Same entries as PtrsLong058823, reached via CODE_0588EC (called from the level load at $0580BF to fill layer 1 initially).
The routine at $058955 that follows is the layer 2 counterpart (its table is outside this section).
